backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining NFT collections, items, user profiles, and ICRC-7 token minting logic with role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—collection selector in the NFT upload form and resizing the Mint button—to their source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, page, hook, and style file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, page title, and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing an NFT collection, using create/update mutation hooks with validation, error display, and German-language labels.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Admin component that lists all NFT collections with edit and delete actions, showing skeletons while loading and a confirmation dialog before deletion.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: A form component for creating and editing NFT items, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and submitting via create/update mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Displays a list of all NFTs in the admin panel with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and delete/edit actions including a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: A card component that displays a legacy artwork's image, title, and description with hover scale and overlay effects.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: A card component for displaying a minted on-chain NFT with its image, token ID, owner principal, mint date, and an optional 'my NFT' highlight.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main page layout wrapping children with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button) and a footer with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A dialog modal for minting a new NFT on ICP, supporting drag-and-drop image upload, title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar with links to main routes; conditionally shows Upload and Admin buttons based on user identity and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that renders an 'NFT' label with a sparkles icon using primary styling.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component for displaying an NFT item with its image, title, collection name, ICP price, on-chain badge, and an ICP explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: Renders a clickable card for an NFT collection with a lazy-loaded image, fallback placeholder, and an external link to the Getgems marketplace.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: Displays a grid of static NFT collection cards for Istvan Seidel's TON Blockchain collections on Getgems, using hardcoded collection data.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A dialog modal that shows detailed NFT information (image, title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price) with copy-to-clipboard fields and an ICP explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting, and ICP architecture for site visitors.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: Displays metadata for a single NFT item including token ID, mint date, price, and a link to the ICP dashboard explorer.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Renders a shortened or full ICP principal address with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a `StaticBlogPost` interface and exports an array of static German-language blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light, red light).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature is unavailable after the backend was replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls `actor.addCollection` to create a new NFT collection and invalidates the `nft-collections` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls `actor.addNFT` to create a new NFT item, then fetches and returns it, with auth error parsing and cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls `actor.deleteCollection` by ID and invalidates both `nft-collections` and `nft-items` queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls `actor.deleteNFT` by ID and invalidates the `nft-items` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub query hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend which was superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Stub query hook that always returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to still display after the blog backend was replaced.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor via `actor.getAllCollections`.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs from the backend via `actor.listAllNFTs`.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend via `actor.getAllNFTs`.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub query hook that always returns null, replacing the old artwork lookup after the backend was superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub query hook that always returns an empty array for category-based artwork lookups after the old backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Stub query hook that always returns null for a single blog post, deferring to static posts after the blog backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the currently authenticated caller's user profile via `actor.getCallerUserProfile`, with combined loading state from actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches NFTs issued to the currently authenticated user via `actor.listMyNFTs`, enabled only when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend via `actor.getNFT`.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection via `actor.getNFTsByCollection`.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` React context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: Query hook that checks whether the current caller has admin privileges via `actor.isCallerAdmin`.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: Mutation hook that mints a new NFT by calling `actor.mintNFT` with title, description, and image, with auth error parsing and cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile via `actor.saveCallerUserProfile` and invalidates the `currentUserProfile` query on success.
Stub mutation hook for contact form submission that always throws an error, indicating the feature is unavailable after the backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: Mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via `actor.updateCollection` and invalidates the `nft-collections` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that calls the backend `updateNFT` actor method and invalidates the `nft-items` query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook that always throws an error, indicating the old artwork upload feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and calls the backend `uploadImage` actor method, returning an `ExternalBlob`.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm light/dark art-themed color palette, including sidebar and chart variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only dashboard page with tabs for managing NFT collections and NFT items, guarding access based on identity and admin role checks.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder page for artwork details that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards, and shows a 'New Post' button for admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image, redirecting non-admins back to the blog.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Blog post detail page that fetches a post by ID from the backend or falls back to static data, displaying the title, date, image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: A contact form page with fields for name, email, subject, and message, using client-side validation and the useSubmitContactForm hook to submit data, with success/error alerts displayed in German.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: A gallery page that displays a hero banner, a randomly selected Walter Russell quote, an NFT collections section, and an NFT explanation section.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: A detail page for a single NFT that fetches NFT and collection data by ID, displays the image, title, description, metadata, and links to the ICP dashboard explorer.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: An NFT gallery page with tabbed views for all NFTs and user-owned NFTs, wallet info display, canister address banner, and modals for minting and viewing NFT details.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: An authenticated upload page that allows users to create NFTs by selecting an image, filling in metadata, choosing a collection, and submitting via the useCreateNFT hook with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: A utility function that copies text to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback to the legacy execCommand approach for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis based on configurable prefix and suffix lengths.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/container-query/animate plugins, and custom keyframes for accordion and fade-in animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking two existing features: adding a collection selector to the NFT mint form and reducing the Mint button size, with no new feature requests or known issues.
